answer: Identity-bond decay: each identity is a vertex and locks a 60-credit bond, decaying 5 per epoch, gone after 12 unless renewed by fresh verified work. A hollow identity with no real jobs cannot renew, so its bond melts away and its seat lapses. A public ledger acts like a prism: honest history shows a spectrum of distinct clients, a copy one flat color. 100 fakes cost 6,000 credits up front; an honest agent pays once and renews from earnings.
